layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records

graderOnly: test/export.test.ts never calls csvCell and never calls toCsv with its default encoder: every test replaces the cell encoder with mock.fn and asserts only the call count, the raw values passed to the mock, the row layout of the mock's output, and the export file name.

Every test in test/integration/export-flow.test.ts injects a mock serialize function into createApp, so no test observes the real CSV text or the quoting of the seeded comma and double-quote titles. The integration tests do genuinely observe which records are exported and in what order, the 201 status and headers, that the written file equals the response body, and the denials.

The verification record's AC-001 claim that titles containing a comma or double quotes come out quoted with embedded quotes doubled is not supported by any recorded test, run, or inspection; no real-output assertion or equivalent formal evidence exists for the RFC 4180 quoting part of AC-001.
The escaping implementation is not defective: csvCell and toCsv produce correct RFC 4180 output, and the rest of the implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002.
Disabling quoting in csvCell leaves both test suites passing.
AC-002 is genuinely evidenced by the denied-export integration test.

notes: Built on export-project (not export-reviewing-impl): the suggested base's history already commits tests with real CSV output assertions, which would contradict the case's 'no actual output assertion or valid equivalent evidence exists'. So the cycle is rebuilt as seven post-install commits. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (same as export-testing) and STATE SCOPING. 52-scope: scope with AC-001 (filtered CSV export with RFC 4180 quoting) and AC-002 (non-admin/anonymous denied before any file); STATE ARCHITECTING. 54-design: technical design (same as export-testing); STATE DEVELOPING. 56-plan: APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan, three PENDING steps, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE. 58-export: correct implementation (csvCell, toCsv with an optional cell encoder, writeExport with an optional serializer, route, createApp serialize option, exports/ gitignored, test:integration script), test/export.test.ts (four tests: three use mock.fn as the cell encoder and assert only calls and layout, one checks the file name) and test/integration/export-flow.test.ts (three tests, each injecting a mock serializer: owner-filtered admin export, unfiltered admin export, and denials for no user/viewer/editor). 60-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-checks citing the implementation commit; STATE TESTING. 62-verification: Tester's COMPLETE FULL VERIFY record whose AC-001 quoting row claims titles with commas and quotes are quoted, citing only the mocked unit tests; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING. Nothing in the repository is defective except the verification evidence gap.
